dataset.source: disposable DB from staged FD E0 CSVs

A_baseline.description: Phase-25 baseline: overall form counts only (points, wins, draws, losses, goals_scored/conceded, goal_diff, matches_played). No per-match averages, no venue split, no recency weighting.

B_plus_form_averages.description: Config A + per-match average features: points_per_match, avg_goals_scored, avg_goals_conceded, clean_sheets, matches_scored for last-5 and last-10 windows.

C_plus_venue_split.description: Config B + venue-specific form features: *_at_home_last_5 and *_at_away_last_5 for both teams.

D_plus_recency_weighted.description: Config C + recency-weighted points: linear weights (oldest=1, newest=n) normalised, for last-5 window.

poisson_sanity_check.message: Poisson predictions identical across all configs for every fold (Poisson does not consume engineered features).

notes: Ablation compares logistic-regression model across 4 feature configurations on identical walk-forward folds.
Config A = Phase-25 baseline (no form averages, no venue split, no recency weighting).
Config B = A + per-match average features.
Config C = B + venue-specific form features.
Poisson model does NOT consume engineered features; its predictions must be identical across all configs (sanity check enforced).
Same-day exclusions: fixture date inclusive (matches on the fixture date are excluded from history).
Cold-start: NaN for rate features when no matches exist; matches_played = 0.
Production DB opened read-only and SHA-256 gated.
Only 3 seasons available; walk-forward limited to 2 folds.
COVID-19 gap in 2019/20 is a documented stationarity discontinuity.
No fabricating matches, odds, predictions, or results.
